turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

Doctor: Hello, I’m your doctor today. What brings you in today? Patient: I’ve had fatigue for about 6 months and I’ve unintentionally lost around 5 kg, but I’m still eating well and haven’t changed my diet or activity. I just feel weaker and more tired than usual.

Have you had any fevers, night sweats, or swollen lymph nodes?
Have you had any fevers, night sweats, or swollen lymph nodes?
No, I haven’t had any fevers or night sweats, and I haven’t noticed any swollen lymph nodes. I also haven’t had any recent infections or bleeding problems.
Have you had any changes in your bowel habits, abdominal pain, blood in your stool, nausea, or vomiting?
“No, I haven’t noticed any changes in my bowel habits, abdominal pain, or blood in my stool. I also haven’t had nausea or vomiting.”
Have you had cough, shortness of breath, chest pain, or coughing up blood?
“No, I haven’t had any cough, shortness of breath, chest pain, or coughing up blood. I mainly just feel persistent fatigue and that unintentional weight loss over the past 6 months.”
Have you noticed increased thirst or urination, heat intolerance, tremor, palpitations, or sweating?

“No, I haven’t had increased thirst or urination, and I don’t feel unusually sensitive to heat. I haven’t noticed tremor, palpitations, or excessive sweating—just this ongoing fatigue and the weight loss.”
Have you had loss of appetite, early satiety, difficulty swallowing, or any new lumps or masses anywhere?
“No, I haven’t had a loss of appetite or early satiety, and I haven’t had any trouble swallowing. I also haven’t noticed any new lumps or masses anywhere.”
Have you had dark stools, black/tarry stools, or any symptoms of anemia like dizziness on standing or shortness of breath with exertion?
“No, my stools haven’t been dark or black, and I haven’t had dizziness when standing. I do feel more short of breath than I used to when exerting myself, but I haven’t had any obvious bleeding.”
Are you having any bone pain, back pain, recurrent infections, or increased urination at night?

“No, I don’t have any bone or back pain, and I haven’t had recurrent infections. I also don’t get up to urinate more than usual at night—my main issue is still just persistent fatigue and the unintentional weight loss.”
Have you noticed yellowing of the eyes/skin, dark urine, itching, or pain/fullness in the upper abdomen?

“No, I haven’t noticed any yellowing of my eyes or skin, dark urine, itching, or any upper abdominal pain or fullness. My main issue is still persistent fatigue and the unintentional 5 kg weight loss over the past 6 months.”
Have you had any headaches, vision changes, new weakness/numbness, or depressed mood?

“No, I haven’t had headaches or any vision changes. I don’t have numbness or new weakness beyond feeling more tired, and I haven’t noticed depressed mood—just this ongoing fatigue and the unintentional weight loss.”
Have you had any joint pains, rashes, mouth ulcers, chronic diarrhea, or known thyroid disease?

Patient: No, I haven’t had joint pains, rashes, mouth ulcers, or chronic diarrhea, and I don’t have any known thyroid disease. It’s mostly just persistent fatigue and the unintentional 5 kg weight loss over the last 6 months.
Have you had any recent blood tests, and if so were you told you were anemic or had abnormal kidney, liver, thyroid, or blood sugar results?
“No, I haven’t had any recent blood tests that I know of, and no one has told me I’m anemic or that my kidney, liver, thyroid, or blood sugar levels were abnormal.”
How old are you, and what sex were you assigned at birth?
“I’m 72 years old, and I was assigned male at birth.”
Have you ever smoked, and if so how much and for how long?
No, I’ve never smoked, and I don’t use illicit drugs. I drink alcohol socially, but not heavily.
Have you had any urinary symptoms such as difficulty starting urination, weak stream, blood in the urine, or waking at night to urinate more often?

“No, I haven’t had difficulty starting urination, a weak stream, blood in my urine, or any increased need to urinate at night—my main concerns are the persistent fatigue and the unintentional 5 kg weight loss over the past 6 months.”
